not_found: This farmer is not in the register.
org: Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources, Kurdistan Region
title: Confirmation of farm registration
body: We confirm that {name}, mobile number {phone}, living in {place}, is registered in the Jutyar farm register with {n} farm(s) covering {area} dunam in total, as listed below.
name: Name
no_farms: No farm is registered for this farmer yet.
unit_note: 1 dunam = 2,500 m². Areas and crops are as the farmer registered them in the Jutyar app.
purpose_ph: For example: a loan from the agricultural bank, a seed programme, an insurance claim
purpose_len: Write a purpose of 3 to 300 characters.
closing: This letter is given at the farmer's request. It confirms the registration only; it is not a proof of land ownership.
check: To check this letter, give its number {no} to the Jutyar Control Room.
check_pending: The letter number is given when the letter is issued.
issue_text: A new letter number is stored for {name} each time a letter is issued. Check the purpose and the language first.
preview_note: This is a preview. Write the purpose, then issue the letter to get its number and print it.
check_ok: This letter was issued by the Jutyar Control Room.
